milestones.claim: Canonical review hosts report noninteractive launcher execution readiness, not only binary/version presence.
milestones.doneMeans: Host readiness output shows launcher shape, support status, first-progress/completion signal, and failureKind for auth, wrong flags, timeout, missing executable, or silent-final-output.

milestones.claim: Review assurance fallback and host dispatch diagnostics use execution-ready host counts.
milestones.doneMeans: Gate diagnostics distinguish availableHostCount from reviewReadyHostCount/executionReadyHostCount and explain why auth, silent-output, or wrong-flag hosts do not qualify for non-human degraded fallback.

milestones.claim: Focused smokes cover Claude stream-json verbose, Codex exec auth, and agy print launcher readiness.
milestones.doneMeans: Smoke tests prove Claude observable launcher is --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json, plain --print is silent/non-progress for long reviewer work, agy --print/--print-timeout is canonical while --prompt-file is rejected, and Codex login/version alone is not review-ready without codex exec success.
